shell_commands: cat specs/hal-engine-doc-gates/spec.md | head -60 && echo "=== grep registry/docs references in tests ===" && grep -rn "weather-tool\|adding-a-tool" --include="*.ts" src/ scripts/ smoke/ | head -20
grep -n "callee-below-caller" -A 20 eslint.config.mjs | head -50; echo ---; grep -rn "specify\|\.md" eslint.config.mjs | head -30
npm run docs:fix 2>&1 | tail -5 && npm run docs:check 2>&1 | tail -5 && git diff --stat
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && npx prettier --check example/weather-tool.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
npm run check:spec-status 2>&1 | tail -3; npm run check:spec-links 2>&1 | tail -3; npm run spec:names 2>&1 | tail -3; npm run check:regions 2>&1 | tail -3; npm run docs:check-paths 2>&1 | tail -3
git stash -q && npm run docs:check-paths 2>&1 | tail -5; git stash pop -q && git status --short

git status --short && git add .specify/spec.md README.md adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md docs/adding-a-tool.md example/weather-tool.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts .lore/dod.md 2>&1; git status --short

git commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs(tools): state the input-validation contract

Repair the two eslint findings CI reported on cc47110: the spec's Status
row now matches its 8-of-8 citation coverage (Shipped), and failingPath
sits below its caller. Close the last facet: example/weather-tool.ts no
longer casts defensively, and docs/adding-a-tool.md, README.md,
.specify/spec.md and ADR-002 describe input reaching an executor as
already schema-valid, extra keys passing through, and a rejection
returned to the model as a tool result rather than thrown.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -2
git fetch origin main 2>&1 | tail -2 && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | tail -5
